pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Sitting Beneath a Rainbow Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn sits beneath a rainbow in this printable coloring page, smiling among small clouds, rounded bushes, and scattered tufts of grass around its hooves. The spiral horn, long wavy mane, and curled tail divide the character into flowing sections, while the rainbow’s wide bands offer larger spaces above the open grassy ground.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Sleeping in the Curve of a Crescent Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn sleeps in the curve of a crescent moon in this printable coloring page, resting its head above folded forehooves among stars and dots. Closed lashes, a small smile, and a spiral horn give the face gentle details, while the wavy mane, flowing tail, and broad moon offer sweeping sections to color.

pages.title: Kawaii Winged Unicorn Flying Above Puffy Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii winged unicorn flies above puffy clouds in this printable coloring page, smiling with raised forelegs beneath a tall spiral horn and scattered stars. Two feathered wings spread across the scene, while a layered mane and curled tail sweep behind the body, creating broad curves beside the smaller feathers and hooves.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Face with a Daisy Crown and Curled Mane Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn face wears a daisy crown in this printable coloring page, with large shining eyes and a curled mane framing its friendly smile. Five daisies and pointed leaves circle the spiral horn, while the mane falls into long winding locks, mixing smaller petals with broad face and hair sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Cuddling a Smiling Star Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn cuddles a smiling star in this printable coloring page, sitting with both forehooves wrapped around it among smaller stars and floating hearts. The star’s closed lashes and oval cheeks complement the unicorn’s bright eyes, while its spiral horn, wavy mane, and long tail create clear sections around the central hug.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Riding a Fluffy Cloud Beside a Shooting Star Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn rides a fluffy cloud beside a shooting star in this printable coloring page, looking upward with one foreleg lifted and a wide smile. The star has its own cheerful face and four trailing bands, while small stars, rounded clouds, and the unicorn’s curling mane and tail fill the open sky.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Peeking Through a Sprinkled Doughnut Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn peeks through a sprinkled doughnut in this printable coloring page, resting its forehooves through the center while its feet and tail show below. The doughnut’s wavy icing edge, long sprinkles, and round dots surround the smiling face, with a spiral horn and flowing mane adding curved shapes inside the ring.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Resting Its Forehooves on a Giant Cupcake Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn rests its forehooves on a giant cupcake in this printable coloring page, smiling beside a cherry above swirled icing decorated with hearts. Long sprinkles and round dots cover the frosting, while a ridged wrapper, spiral horn, wavy mane, and curled tail give the coloring sheet both narrow and broad sections.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Licking an Ice Cream Cone Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn licks an ice cream cone in this printable coloring page, holding the treat with one forehoof while sitting beneath a tall spiral horn. Sprinkles dot the rounded scoop above a crisscross waffle cone, and the unicorn’s large eyes, wavy mane, and curled tail leave flowing sections around the smaller dessert details.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Sipping Bubble Tea Through a Straw Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn sips bubble tea through a straw in this printable coloring page, sitting with both forehooves wrapped around the cup beneath its smiling muzzle. Round pearls collect near the bottom under a domed lid, while oval cheeks, a spiral horn, and long curled mane and tail add simple shapes around the drink.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Blowing a Bubble Gum Bubble Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn blows a bubble gum bubble in this printable coloring page, sitting upright with wide eyes and its forelegs planted between rounded back hooves. Two highlight shapes mark the large bubble beside its muzzle, while a tall spiral horn, flowing mane, and striped curls in the tail offer longer sections to color.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Licking a Swirled Lollipop Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn licks a swirled lollipop in this printable coloring page, holding the long stick in one forehoof while sitting with its tongue reaching forward. The candy’s single spiral echoes the curved horn and long mane, with large shining eyes, rounded hooves, and a curled tail filling the simple character-focused coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Baking Star-shaped Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn bakes star-shaped cookies in this printable coloring page, stirring a mixing bowl behind a table holding ingredients, a cutter, and a baking tray. A window, shelf, plant, heart-marked jar, whisk, and oven mitt complete the kitchen, adding small tools and patterns beside the unicorn’s broad body and flowing mane.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Having a Tea Party with a Bunny Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn shares a tea party with a bunny in this printable coloring page, sitting on small stools beside a table covered with heart designs. Both hold scalloped teacups, with a heart-marked teapot, dotted cookies, and a frosted cupcake between them, giving the coloring sheet small treats beside the larger animal and furniture shapes.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn in a Party Hat Beside a Birthday Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn wears a party hat beside a birthday cake in this printable coloring page, smiling among floating hearts and stars around its curled mane. Three striped candles top the cake’s wavy icing and dotted layers, while circles and a fluffy pom-pom decorate the hat behind the unicorn’s spiral horn.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Popping Out of a Gift Box Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn pops out of a gift box in this printable coloring page, smiling with its forehooves resting above a large ribbon tied in front. Four open flaps surround the flowing mane, and wide ribbon bands cross the box, creating large straight-edged sections beside the curved horn, bow loops, and pointed ribbon ends.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Beside a Bunch of Heart-shaped Balloons Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn stands beside heart-shaped balloons in this printable coloring page, tilting its smiling face toward the bunch above a small tied weight below. Four balloon hearts overlap with narrow strings running to a bow, while the spiral horn, long wavy mane, and curling tail give the character broad flowing sections to color.

pages.title: Two Kawaii Unicorn Friends Touching Noses Beneath a Heart Coloring Page
pages.description: Two kawaii unicorn friends touch noses beneath a heart in this printable coloring page, standing face to face with bright eyes and matching curved smiles. Their spiral horns rise on either side of the large heart, while long wavy manes, curling tails, and rounded hooves create mirrored shapes across the friendship coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Mother Unicorn Nuzzling Her Foal Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii mother unicorn nuzzles her foal in this printable coloring page, bending her head toward the smaller unicorn as both sit with closed eyes. Their spiral horns, soft smiles, layered manes, and curved tails repeat in different sizes, leaving broad body shapes beside the flowing hair sections in this family scene.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Hugging a Teddy Bear Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn hugs a teddy bear in this printable coloring page, sitting with closed eyes and both forehooves wrapped around the small smiling stuffed toy. Round ears, oval paw pads, and the teddy’s simple muzzle add small details, while the unicorn’s broad hooves, spiral horn, and long flowing mane frame the embrace.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Watching a Butterfly Land on Its Nose Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn watches a butterfly land on its nose in this printable coloring page, standing among little flowers and grass with wide curious eyes. Heart-like wing panels, small circles, and curled antennae decorate the butterfly, while the unicorn’s spiral horn, layered mane, and long wavy tail offer sweeping shapes beside the tiny meadow details.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Giving a Kitten a Ride on Its Back Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn gives a kitten a ride in this printable coloring page, standing with one foreleg bent while the small cat sits on its back. Both have large shining eyes, with the kitten’s whiskers, tiny paws, and upright curling tail adding details above the unicorn’s broad body, spiral horn, and long wavy hair.

pages.title: Kawaii Mermaid Unicorn Swimming Beside a Seashell Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii mermaid unicorn swims beside a seashell in this printable coloring page, floating with raised forehooves above an open shell holding a round pearl. Scalloped scales cover the curved tail before its wide fins, while bubbles, a flowing mane, a spiral horn, and small seabed stones complete the underwater coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Beside a Fairy Sitting on a Toadstool Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn sits beside a fairy on a toadstool in this printable coloring page, with both smiling above small flowers and grass around the stem. The fairy’s veined wings, flower hair accessory, pointed ears, and petal skirt add fine shapes beside the mushroom spots and the unicorn’s long mane, horn, and rounded hooves.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Nuzzling a Little Princess in a Crown Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn nuzzles a little princess in this printable coloring page, leaning toward her crown as both sit with closed eyes and gentle smiles. Heart shapes decorate the crown and bodice, while puffed sleeves, clasped hands, long curling hair, and a wide folded skirt create varied sections beside the unicorn’s flowing mane.

pages.title: Kawaii Princess Unicorn Wearing a Tiara Beside a Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii princess unicorn wears a tiara beside a castle in this printable coloring page, standing on grass before a winding path and three flagged towers. Heart decorations repeat on the crown and castle walls, while the long wavy mane, spiral horn, and curling tail provide flowing shapes beside the building’s straight sections.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Meeting a Friendly Knight at a Castle Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn meets a friendly knight at a castle gate in this printable coloring page, smiling beside the child’s plumed helmet, armor, and long cape. Clasped hands and a small shield emblem decorate the knight, while stone paving, rounded bushes, towers, and an arched wooden doorway add background sections around the pair.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Following Fireflies Along a Forest Path Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn follows fireflies along a forest path in this printable coloring page, lifting one forehoof beneath smiling insects between two tall trees nearby. Curled antennae and short radiating lines surround the three fireflies, while leaves, grass tufts, bushes, and stepping stones border the winding path beside the unicorn’s flowing mane.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Drinking From a Stream Below a Small Waterfall Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn drinks from a stream in this printable coloring page, lowering its head toward circular ripples below a small waterfall surrounded by rocks and bushes. Its mane hangs beside the muzzle, while smooth boulders, grass tufts, and flowing water lines divide the landscape into broad sections and smaller natural details.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Watering a Pot of Daisies Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn waters a pot of daisies in this printable coloring page, sitting beside three blossoms and tipping a small watering can above their leaves. A few outlined drops fall from the dotted spout, while the flowerpot, rounded hooves, spiral horn, and flowing mane and tail offer larger shapes around the petals.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Wearing Round Glasses and Reading a Book Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn wears round glasses while reading in this printable coloring page, sitting with a large open book held between both forehooves beneath its smile. The oversized frames circle bright eyes, and the book’s blank covers contrast with thin page edges, a spiral horn, and long curls in the mane and tail.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Painting a Rainbow on an Easel Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn paints a rainbow on an easel in this printable coloring page, holding a brush against the canvas and a palette near its lap. Small outlined paint spots decorate the palette, while the rainbow ends in rounded clouds, combining broad bands and straight easel legs with the unicorn’s flowing mane and tail.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Dancing Beneath a Disco Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn dances beneath a disco ball in this printable coloring page, balancing on one back hoof with both forelegs raised among sparkles and dots. A grid covers the hanging ball, and rays extend around it above the curled mane and tail, while segmented floor shapes mark the small dance area below.

pages.title: Kawaii Superhero Unicorn Wearing a Mask and Cape Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii superhero unicorn wears a mask and cape in this printable coloring page, standing with a bright smile and long hair flowing around its shoulders. The cape sweeps outward from a round collar clasp, while the eye mask, spiral horn, layered mane, and curled tail create distinct shapes against the clear background.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Sitting on a Garden Swing Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn sits on a garden swing in this printable coloring page, holding two twisted ropes that hang from a leafy branch above its head. Its back hooves dangle beneath the wooden seat, while flowers, bushes, grass, and curling tail sections add smaller details around the broad face and body of this garden coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Riding in a Hot Air Balloon Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn rides in a hot air balloon basket in this printable coloring page, peeking over the woven rim among four rounded clouds in the sky. Heart decorations join scalloped bands around the balloon, while striped support ropes and basket blocks offer smaller patterns beneath the large curved panels overhead.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Rolling a Beach Ball with Its Nose Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn rolls a beach ball with its nose in this printable coloring page, standing beside gentle waves with small stones and a seashell on the sand. Wide curved panels divide the large ball, while a spiral horn, layered mane, and flowing tail add longer shapes around the unicorn’s bent foreleg and smiling face.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Relaxing in a Bubble Bath Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn relaxes in a bubble bath in this printable coloring page, resting its forehooves on a curved tub rim while bubbles float around its head. Rounded foam surrounds the flowing mane, and oval highlights decorate the floating bubbles, leaving large spaces across the tub and smaller shapes near the spiral horn and hooves.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Roasting a Marshmallow Beside a Campfire Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn roasts a marshmallow beside a campfire in this printable coloring page, sitting with a long stick above flames and a ring of stones. Cut logs, pine trees, distant hills, bushes, and scattered grass fill the campsite, adding small natural details around the unicorn’s broad body, wavy mane, and curled tail.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Carrying a Valentine Envelope in Its Mouth Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn carries a Valentine envelope in its mouth in this printable coloring page, standing with bright eyes beneath a spiral horn and swept mane. A heart seals the envelope’s triangular flaps, while the long wavy tail and rounded hooves provide broad sections around the smaller letter in this simple friendship coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn in Bunny Ears Beside an Easter Egg Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn wears bunny ears beside an Easter egg basket in this printable coloring page, smiling above small flowers and patches of grass at its hooves. One tall ear bends at the tip, while stripes, zigzags, and dots decorate the eggs beneath a woven handle and large ribbon bow, adding varied patterns to color.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Trick-or-treating with a Pumpkin Pail Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn goes trick-or-treating with a pumpkin pail in this printable coloring page, stepping forward above fallen leaves and small grass tufts on the ground. Candy pieces and a spiral lollipop fill the smiling jack-o’-lantern bucket, while the unicorn’s curled mane, long tail, and tall horn create broader flowing shapes around it.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Wearing a Santa Hat Beside a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn wears a Santa hat beside a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, smiling near wrapped presents beneath a large star tree topper. Round ornaments and bead garlands decorate the layered branches, while fluffy hat trim, ribbon bows, and the unicorn’s curled mane and tail offer a mix of simple shapes.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn Gliding on Ice Skates Across a Frozen Pond Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn glides on ice skates across a frozen pond in this printable coloring page, lifting its forelegs with one back skate stretched behind it. Bows decorate the boots, and curving skate marks cross the ice below, while snowy pine trees, rounded banks, and the flowing mane and tail complete the winter scene.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn on Sandy Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn sits on a sandy beach on this printable coloring page, raising one rounded hoof in a wave beneath a smiling sun and small clouds. Broad ocean waves stretch behind its curled mane and tail, with seashells, a small stone, and a thin rectangular border completing the seaside scene.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn in Enchanted Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn stands in an enchanted forest on this printable coloring page, wearing flowers near a patterned horn above large eyes and a small smile. Hearts, stars, and blossoms decorate the curled mane and tail, while spiral-marked trees, mushrooms, stones, flowers, and a winding path fill the setting.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn in Galaxy Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn sits in a galaxy garden on this printable coloring page, wearing a flower crown and small necklace beneath a sky of stars and crescent moons. Moon and star patterns fill the long mane and curled tail, while flowers, rocks, leafy branches, and a winding path surround the seated figure.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn in Butterfly Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn sits in a butterfly garden on this printable coloring page, smiling beneath a flower garland as patterned butterflies hover around the striped horn. Stars decorate the flowing mane and tail beside a heart on the body, while daisies, tulips, leafy stems, and grass fill the garden foreground.

pages.title: Kawaii Unicorn in Rose Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: A kawaii unicorn stands in a rose garden on this printable coloring page, wearing roses in a flowing mane and curled tail beneath a tall striped horn. Stars, spirals, and a small flower decorate its body, while large layered roses, closed buds, pointed leaves, and smaller blossoms form a dense floral frame.
